description: Ministry of Defence - Duties & Functions assigned to the State Minister of Defence from the date 11.09.2015
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (President Maithripala Sirisena) and provides detailed portfolio responsibilities, including specific duties, functions, and the departments/statutory institutions under his authority as Minister of Defence. The content contains both the "who" (named government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities), making it a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
